items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: We work real well together. We’ve done it a couple of times now and it always works real good.

ctx.x: Well we just talk back and forth, but it was great. We had nothing, no kind of plan or anything. But we work real well together. We’ve done it a couple of times now and it always works real good. Because he’s very confident and he’s Dirty Harry, you know he doesn’t have to worry about anything. And he’s great to work with. And he loves jazz too.
